name: BIGTIME 1.0.3
description:
# Bugs Fixed
- Sliders sometimes fully unresponsive
- Preset reset gesture can get confused if used while looper is first recording without the loop length being set
- Tap subdivisions update live when adjusted via CC
- Repeated CC28 messages no longer occasionally turn off display
- LOOP will start in play going from LONG to LOOP over MIDI and from the button
	- LOOP still starts cleared when coming from SHORT or MOD
- Bypass mute time much quicker
- Looper maintains midi sync when outside the main menu
- Looper attempts to undo footswitch commands that come in as part of changing menus
	- This works as advertised for PLAY, STOP, and CLEARED. The pedal will briefly change states and then go back once the menu change command is recognized
	- For RECORD the pedal returns to PLAY. This prevents loops from getting degraded while in less performance oriented menu.
internalNotes:
- Secret aux jack hardware config midi message added
- New tap subdivisions updates involve a new implementation that does need some serious vetting before 1.1
